product_name: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now supports configuring the live migration `maxDowntime` parameter in the kubevirt migration policy to limit how long a VM can be paused at the end of migration.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now supports configuring the live migration `maxDowntime` parameter in the kubevirt migration policy to limit how long a VM can be paused at the end of migration.

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now supports the `virtctl diagnose` command for diagnosing VM issues.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now supports the `virtctl diagnose` command for diagnosing VM issues.

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now supports the `virtctl snapshot` command to collect VMRuntime logs for debugging.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now supports the `virtctl snapshot` command to collect VMRuntime logs for debugging.

features.feature_summary: Adds support for applying label updates to GVM resources at runtime by patching labels on VM Pods.
features.extended_definition: Adds support for applying label updates to GVM resources at runtime by patching labels on VM Pods.

features.feature_summary: Adds support for configuring a GVM's running state (Running or Stopped) through the runningState field in the GVM resource spec.
features.extended_definition: Adds support for configuring a GVM's running state (Running or Stopped) through the runningState field in the GVM resource spec.

features.feature_name: Anthos Clusters on Bare Metal 1.28.0 availability
features.feature_summary: Anthos Clusters on bare metal version 1.28.0 is now available for download.
features.extended_definition: Anthos Clusters on bare metal version 1.28.0 is now available for download.

features.feature_summary: Added support for local image caching within the same namespace.
features.extended_definition: Added support for local image caching within the same namespace.

features.feature_name: Anthos clusters on bare metal 1.16.0 availability
features.feature_summary: Made Anthos clusters on bare metal version 1.16.0 available for download.
features.extended_definition: Made Anthos clusters on bare metal version 1.16.0 available for download.

features.feature_name: Live VM CD-ROM hot-plug and ejection
features.feature_summary: Added support for inserting and ejecting CD-ROM devices on running virtual machines without interruption, including use of pre-open slots for later insertion.
features.extended_definition: Added support for inserting and ejecting CD-ROM devices on running virtual machines without interruption, including use of pre-open slots for later insertion.

features.feature_name: Persistent UEFI and TPM state for VMs
features.feature_summary: Added support for persisting UEFI and trusted platform module (TPM) state across VM restarts when enabled via VMRuntime feature gate VMPersistentState.
features.extended_definition: Added support for persisting UEFI and trusted platform module (TPM) state across VM restarts when enabled via VMRuntime feature gate VMPersistentState.

features.feature_name: Rocky Linux GPU guest OS support
features.feature_summary: Added GPU support for Rocky Linux guest operating systems, with package management via dnf.
features.extended_definition: Added GPU support for Rocky Linux guest operating systems, with package management via dnf.

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now upgrades base images to include security fixes for vulnerabilities.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now upgrades base images to include security fixes for vulnerabilities.

features.feature_name: Maintenance-mode triggered VM eviction and migration during cluster upgrades
features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now triggers VM eviction and live migration during cluster upgrades only after a node enters maintenance mode, using Anthos-on-Bare-Metal's entering maintenance window timeout and best-effort migration to already-upgraded nodes.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now triggers VM eviction and live migration during cluster upgrades only after a node enters maintenance mode, using Anthos-on-Bare-Metal's entering maintenance window timeout and best-effort migration to already-upgraded nodes.

features.feature_name: MIG controller resilience to Kubernetes API server failures
features.feature_summary: Makes the MIG controller retry connections when the Kubernetes API server experiences temporary failures.
features.extended_definition: Makes the MIG controller retry connections when the Kubernetes API server experiences temporary failures.

features.feature_name: Robin storage class fencing for VM Runtime HA
features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now triggers Robin storage fencing during HA failover to block access from failed nodes, enabling HA operation with Robin-backed block storage.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now triggers Robin storage fencing during HA failover to block access from failed nodes, enabling HA operation with Robin-backed block storage.

features.feature_summary: Adds support for Rocky Linux 8 as a guest operating system.
features.extended_definition: Adds support for Rocky Linux 8 as a guest operating system.

features.feature_summary: Adds support for SLES11 as a guest operating system.
features.extended_definition: Adds support for SLES11 as a guest operating system.

features.feature_name: Softening KubeVirt migration taints during cluster upgrades
features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now uses soft migration taints for KubeVirt during upgrades to address issues in single-control-node upgrade scenarios.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now uses soft migration taints for KubeVirt during upgrades to address issues in single-control-node upgrade scenarios.

features.feature_summary: Adds support for Ubuntu 22.04 as a guest operating system.
features.extended_definition: Adds support for Ubuntu 22.04 as a guest operating system.

features.feature_name: Virtio non-transitional driver configuration for SLES11
features.feature_summary: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now supports configuring the virtio non-transitional driver for SLES11 by exposing the KubeVirt knob at the KubeVM layer.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now supports configuring the virtio non-transitional driver for SLES11 by exposing the KubeVirt knob at the KubeVM layer.

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime supports resizing VM disks, and when supported by the storage provider it automatically expands the underlying PVC and VM disk accordingly.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime supports resizing VM disks, and when supported by the storage provider it automatically expands the underlying PVC and VM disk accordingly.

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now improves VNC access by adding a tablet mode for a better VNC experience.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now improves VNC access by adding a tablet mode for a better VNC experience.

features.feature_summary: VM Runtime now enables optimized Hyper-V settings automatically for Windows guest OS on physical server environments to improve performance.
features.extended_definition: VM Runtime now enables optimized Hyper-V settings automatically for Windows guest OS on physical server environments to improve performance.
